blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Make the complete 3/5/10 tactical encounter and its weapon, enemy, and victory motion continuously playable, readable, and deterministically qualifiable while preserving the authored environment, coupled AK-74M/Saiga-12 viewmodel, mouse-look behavior, and clean boot.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate already contains the 18 stable enemy instances, tactical AI states, animation bindings, recoil, and victory presentation, but acceptance remains unqualified because the uninterrupted Alpha→Bravo→Charlie scenario and temporal motion windows were lost when the runtime collector disconnected. The existing bounded event rings do not provide a durable per-run completeness summary, so missing evidence cannot be cleanly distinguished from a gameplay or presentation defect.

stop_conditions: Stop and restore the last passing implementation if clean boot, ordinary movement, independent mouse-look axes, or the coupled viewmodel binding regresses.
Do not replace, split, or surgically alter the preserved authored map, character packages, or AK-74M/Saiga-12 hands-and-weapon component; isolate state or adapter defects around their existing roots.
Do not treat another Godot MCP disconnect as a candidate defect. If rebind fails again, retain the candidate and return control to GameLoop Runtime with the exact missing validation cells.
Do not expand into deferred bomb-finale, product-shell, general feedback, performance, or decorative environment backlog work.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different strategy from prior progression tuning: preserve direct actor instances across the run, repair authoritative AI-to-presentation bindings where necessary, and add compact cumulative qualification summaries that survive checkpoint restores. This isolates AI behavior, animation binding, and host collection failures without repeating transform tuning or replacing preserved assets.

code: Run the frozen clean-boot/import check and require zero parser, missing-resource, invalid-node-path, or signal-connection errors.
Inspect candidate state schemas for stable run/actor/event IDs, monotonic sequences, bounded memory, exactly-once shot/result submission, and checkpoint-safe reset behavior.

Exercise focused source or scene tests for roster cardinality, activation order, occupancy rejection, blocked fire, avoidance velocity consumption, recoil baseline recovery, animation-time progression, and idempotent victory reset.
runtime: After GameLoop Runtime rebinds Godot MCP to the exact candidate, Tester runs title→gameplay→Alpha→Bravo→Charlie without reset and samples all 18 stable IDs, region activation, route pressure, movement, separation, perception, blocked/accepted fire, reload, hurt, death, and cumulative coverage.

Capture one automatic-fire sequence with left fire held for at least 2000 ms and nonzero mouse motion overlapping the hold; pair fire peak, repeated peak, release, and settled recovery frames with weapon/controller state.

For representative active enemies, pair locomotion, aim window, fire, reload, hurt, and death frames with actor AI state, animation name, animation position, safe velocity, shot ID, ammo, health, collision, and navigation state.

Trigger legal defusal success and pair pullback, orbit, front/three-quarter dance, and result-entry frames with victory phase, camera transform, avatar visibility, animation position, and exactly-once result state.
visual: Use shipped gameplay framing: verify route-pressure enemies are visible before objective entry and that multiple actors read across distinct depths, routes, and elevations without overlap or wall embedding.

Compare hip, sustained-fire peak, recovery, enemy locomotion/aim/fire/hurt/death, and victory frames; require visibly different poses or transforms consistent with paired temporal state rather than static labels.

Preserve the current industrial environment and tactical HUD. Confirm enemies, muzzle action, impact surfaces, reticle, objectives, and victory avatar remain legible against the dense grounded-realistic scene without decorative map expansion.

done_when: One run owns exactly 18 unique enemy IDs with immutable 3/5/10 Alpha/Bravo/Charlie allocation, unique route slots, region-correct activation, and persistent alive/dead state.
Alpha route pressure occurs before point entry; Bravo and Charlie activate only after the preceding objective; inactive later-region actors remain hidden and non-combatant.

Each activated actor can autonomously demonstrate perception/telegraph, navigation or search, aim, authoritative fire, reload, hurt, lethal shutdown, and cleanup without first-frame fire, wall damage, capsule overlap, or more than three seconds of unexplained no-progress.

Navigation submits desired velocity and consumes safe avoidance velocity; cumulative summaries expose nearest-neighbour distance, grounded/nav occupancy, blocked-shot reasons, ammo, shot IDs, and state coverage per actor.

A compact run-scoped qualification ledger reports region milestones and per-actor state/event coverage without depending on the truncating raw receipt ring, and checkpoint restore preserves identity/progression while resetting only volatile perception and presentation state.
tasks.instructions: Repair the existing direct enemy-instance lifecycle rather than retuning transforms. Keep the fixed roster and authored route slots, verify activation and checkpoint restoration against authoritative mission state, and close any AI-to-presentation or navigation-avoidance binding defect discovered.
